title: Chassis Deformation & Structural Safety Standard
citation: Illustrative Motor Comprehensive Policy — Section 4 (Loss Settlement), Clause 4.2
text: Where accidental collision impact causes direct deformation, bending, or displacement to the vehicle chassis, unibody floorpan, quarter-panel unibody structure, or central pillar frame such that repair cannot restore certified roadworthiness without compromising occupant passenger compartment integrity, the vehicle shall be classified as an outright Total Loss regardless of the economic repair percentage.
